Name: Unclassified
Definition: The exact system, use, population, or accountable actor is unresolved.

Name: Declared
Definition: The actor has completed system identity, function, intended use, population, data, lifecycle, and claim declarations.

Name: Evidence-traceable
Definition: Material claims, risks, controls, incidents, and lifecycle states link to exact evidence and limitations.
Minimum_Evidence: Evidence manifest, claim registry, configuration links, endpoint and incident records

Name: Independently assessed
Definition: Independent multidisciplinary and participant-inclusive assessment has examined the applicable kernel requirements.
Minimum_Evidence: Independent findings, objections, participant record, defect and exception ledgers

Name: Lifecycle assured
Definition: Longitudinal monitoring, updates, incidents, continuity, withdrawal, reassessment triggers, and support obligations are operational.
Minimum_Evidence: Monitoring, change, safety, security, continuity, and post-use evidence

Name: Publicly accountable
Definition: The protected assurance case supports a bounded public summary, monitoring indicators, correction process, remedy routes, and periodic re-evaluation.
Minimum_Evidence: Public assurance summary, monitoring report, remedy and correction records, current decision
